output_contract:
Stage B record exact keys:
`slot_id, identity, boundary_status, technology_family, claim_trust_level, trust_basis, policy_reference, holds, classification_confidence, confidence_by_property, assessed_benefit, supporting_source_ids, counter_source_ids, applicability_bridge, evidence_limitations, research_admission_candidate, new_submission_recommended, application_facts, fit_assessment, manufacturer_positioning, intended_role, concise_de, deeper_de, stage_a_to_final_changes`.
Identity is the exact packet identity object, without added keys. Null family/trust/basis/policy is appropriate when not finalized applicable. A source-version identity is not a scanned bottle. The default recommendation fact is a simulation, not a database update. `holds` exact keys: `identity, boundary, claim_trust, protocol, fit`, each bounded string array. Confidence-by-property exact keys: `identity, boundary, technology, policy, protocol, fit`, each a confidence value or null if not applicable. Explanations/rationale max 2000 characters; concise German max 500, deeper German max 2500. Source arrays contain registered IDs, max 20. Changes and evidence limitations are bounded string arrays.

Application facts exact keys:
`selected_direction_source_id, placement, physical_format, hair_state, application_area, amount, dilution, contact_time, working_time, sequence, conditioner, cadence, brand_partners, source_variants`.
Each field except selected source, sequence and source_variants is a fact node `{value, source_ids, limitations}`. An unknown node has null (or the specified unknown-kind value), no invented fact, and a reason. A source fact must cite at least one applicable inspected source ID. The following value shapes are exact:
- placement: `pre_shampoo | post_shampoo | before_or_after_shampoo | null`; do not infer placement where directions lack order.
- physical_format, application_area, amount, dilution: string or null. A role/title alone is not physical texture.
- hair_state: array of source-backed descriptors or null.
- contact_time: `{kind, minutes_min, minutes_max, branches}`; kind `fixed | range | conditional | no_wait | unknown`; numbers nullable; branches `{condition, minutes_min, minutes_max}`. No inferred maximum or minimum.
- working_time: `{minutes_min, minutes_max}` or null. Active massage time is distinct from extra dwell.
- sequence: array of `{action, requirement, source_ids}`; requirement `instruction | recommended | optional`. Separate selected directions from optional partner recommendations.
- conditioner: `{before, after, after_timing}` or null. Before/after strings bounded; do not infer a prohibition merely from absence.
- cadence: `{kind, times_per_week_min, times_per_week_max, washes_min, washes_max, branches}`; kind `weekly | wash_interval | conditional | unknown`; numbers nullable; each branch `{condition, kind, times_per_week_min, times_per_week_max, washes_min, washes_max}`. Unknown cadence has all numbers null and empty branches. Conditional has top-level numbers null.
- brand_partners: array of `{name_or_role, requirement}`, requirement `required | recommended | optional`. Empty if not stated, not evidence of equivalence.
- source_variants: array of `{source_id, selected, summary}`; retain meaningful non-selected differing directions. Selected packet directions remain primary.

Fit exact keys: `fine, normal, coarse, rationale, source_ids`. Nullable booleans separate diameter from pattern/porosity; absence of evidence remains null. Do not convert generic maker positioning to proven all-diameter fit. Manufacturer positioning is bounded attributed text, not an independent assignment.

Use selected direction sources for factual instructions regardless of boundary exclusion/review; an excluded category product can still have useful researched directions. No inferred dose, cadence, physical format, superiority, mandatory brand purchase, or scientific low-trust rationale. Preserve raw Stage A observations and explain candidate-to-final changes with source/rule references. Write `records.json` and `notes.md`; stop.

policy.existing_catalog_matches: not evaluated in this offline validation; preserve approvals and link instead of duplicating if matched later
policy.enrichment_scope: All eight original pilot products, unchanged exact trust. These four validation products are not approved new enrichment/recommendation targets.

source_registry.scope: current EU Bond Curl Rehab Salve product page, 237 ml option
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: Full English INCI transcribed into V01. Specific targeted pre-shampoo treatment claiming reinforcement of three bond types; no disclosed product concentration, pH or independent molecular endpoint.

Wet hair without washing first. Apply generously root to tip, coat evenly and detangle. Low porosity: 15 minutes every 4-5 washes; medium: 20 minutes every 3-4 washes; high: 30 minutes every 2-3 washes. Rinse, shampoo and condition.
limitations: Actual pack not supplied; manufacturer warns that formula lists can change.
Product title salve does not itself establish an applied cream texture.

source_registry.scope: DE 237 ml listing and translated formula/directions
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: DE current ingredient sequence corroborates EU English sequence, including the gluconamide/gluconate pair and citric acid.
DE instructions corroborate the three porosity/time/wash-interval branches and rinse before shampoo and conditioner.
limitations: Translated ingredient spelling is not proof of batch equality; no supplied pack.

source_registry.scope: DE Haarkur Keratin Repair 300 ml, article 1688653, listed GTIN 4070765002003
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: Complete INCI transcribed into V02.
Claims concern keratin/peptides and a Pro-Strength label for damaged hair.
Spread gently through damp lengths and ends 1-2 times weekly, leave 2-3 minutes and rinse thoroughly. No explicit shampoo/conditioner ordering or physical texture in the inspected text.
limitations: Listed GTIN is not a scanned pack; marketing name does not identify a distinct molecular ingredient.

source_registry.scope: DE Pro-Keratin Filler Deep Repair Intensive Haarkur 200 ml, formula 1261267 / Z70029743/2
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: Complete INCI transcribed into V03.
Maker describes Pro-Keratin plus marula oil, conditioning, filling and strengthening hair; no specific calcium-management or citric-acid repair claim in this text.
Before OR after shampoo on damp hair, massage through lengths/ends, leave 5 minutes, optional towel/shower-cap warmth, rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Cadence and numerical dose unstated.
limitations: Rich formula is a description, not enough to certify cream texture.
No actual pack.

source_registry.scope: DE Absolut Repair Molecular Rinse-Off Serum current product-page version; size/GTIN unstated in inspected text
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: Complete INCI transcribed into V04.

Maker claims 2% peptide bonders and five amino acids, molecular repair, a serum-like texture and suitability for damaged hair; this does not identify a listed sh-Oligopeptide-78 technology or an acid/calcium role.

Use in place of a rinse-out mask. Recommended after matching shampoo: detangle wet hair, divide into two sections, use 2-3 pumps on one section and repeat elsewhere. Normally lengths/ends; very damaged hair may receive root-to-tip application. Work through 1-2 minutes; no separate dwell required; rinse thoroughly. Optional intensive-care Metal DX mask and recommended matching leave-in.
Two-years-damage headline is footnoted to a shampoo+serum+leave-in instrumental system test; another molecular-repair claim refers to 15 serum applications, not proof of one-use superiority.
limitations: Size and scanned pack unresolved; source-version identity, not exact bottle certification.
Concentration label is a branded complex claim, not ingredient dose.
No study protocol, comparator or data inspected.

source_registry.scope: manufacturer editorial and historical study disclosure
source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient
observations: Mentions third-party data and an independent user study of 120 volunteers in January 2021; full study, comparator and formula equivalence unavailable.

Editorial says minimum 15 minutes, 30 for medium/high porosity, differing from current product-page medium 20 minutes. It recommends the same conditional wash intervals and matching shampoo/conditioner.
limitations: Not an inspected peer-reviewed study.
Select current local product directions, retaining this differing editorial separately.

observations: Names FiberHance BM solution as Hydroxypropylgluconamide (and) Hydroxypropylammonium Gluconate in a supplier example mask.
limitations: This is not Curlsmith's formulation, supplier verification or product dose.

source_registry.commercial_context: publisher sells the described product or ingredient

observations: Author reports tighter curl definition and shrinkage plus shine after Bond Curl, using a routine comparison against OLAPLEX No.3.

Article inspected; linked video not independently watched.

source_registry.scope: original anecdotal discussion, historical unspecified pack
source_registry.commercial_context: commercial interests unknown; do not infer independence
observations: Original poster reports dry feel and difficult detangling after Bond Curl; another user reports no similar problem.
Experiences and self-attribution to protein are not controlled causal evidence.
limitations: Formula/market, routine and hair diameter not verified; do not derive a hard protein-overload or fit rule.

observations: A commenter reports improved feel/curls while alternating Curlsmith and OLAPLEX; explicitly not complete erasure of bleach damage.
limitations: Multi-product routine cannot isolate Curlsmith; pack/market/version unverified.
